Create your first AI video for free! by Team, journal
Create your first AI video for free!
Yesterday
Ready to see your ideas move? Until November 30th, eligible non-Core Members can create their first AI video for free with Video Creator. Here's how it works: Head to Video Creator Create a video with Hailuo Enjoy your free creation! [DEVIATION] Eligibility  This benefit is available to eligible non-Core Members who signed up more than 30 days ago. The offer includes one free 5-second video using Hailuo and runs through November 30th.   Ready to give it a try? Try Video Creator Share your feedback and join the conversation in our General Feedback Forum thread. Please follow our Etiquette policy and Forum rules.
DevMeet: Tokyo 東京 2026 by Team, journal
DevMeet: Tokyo 東京 2026
Oct 20, 2026
[EMOTE] Konnichiwa, Tokyo! Our next DevMeet is heading your way. DeviantArt couldn't be more excited to meet up in a space where Japan's artists and the global DeviantArt community can share creativity and inspiration. Stay in the loop through our Japan Community Group. 日本のみなさん、こんにちは！次のDevMeetが、いよいよ東京にやってきます。日本のクリエイターと世界中のDeviantArt コミュニティが、創造性とインスピレーションを分かち合うために集まるこの特別な機会を、DeviantArt一同、心から楽しみにしています。最新情報は日本コミュニティグループ\[EMOTE] [DEVIATION] Date: November 17, 2026  Time: 17:00 - 20:00 Location: Akihabara ENTAS [EMOTE] This event will be in both Japanese and English. Polls in more places by Team, journal
Polls in more places
Oct 13, 2026
The community has always loved seeing the results of a good poll and peppering their opinions into other polls. Now your favorite way to share your opinion is seamlessly woven into your experience. Embed polls in journals, statuses, deviation descriptions, and custom sections, with new flair like bold, italics, and the ability to include images in your questions and answers.  [DEVIATION] Where are you most excited to use polls? • Journals • Statuses • Deviation descriptions • Custom sections Stack more than one poll for a whole survey, or get to the point with a single status poll. Grab visitors to your profile with a featured poll in a custom section. Sellers with Subscriptions can also post a status or journal poll and submit it to their tier to make it subscriber-only.  Creators can now (optionally) vote in their own poll, so you can add your voice to the results too! Embedding means you can even have multiple polls in one journal!  How do you like to use polls? 🤔 • Letting
Easily grow your Messages community with shared links by Team, journal
Easily grow your Messages community with shared links
Sep 29, 2026
New for Messages Channels by popular request: invite links. Make one, share it anywhere, and let people join with a click instead of hunting for their username. Quick facts:  Links expire in 7 days, but you can make a new one anytime Disable a link whenever you want Once the link is disabled, it stays off Only you can create invite links for your Channel. After that, anyone holding the link can join, so be sure to share it thoughtfully, and remember: you can always remove someone if needed. [DEVIATION] Share the links and welcome your growing community! Head over to Messages now to try it out! Share your feedback and join the conversation in our Messages Forum thread. Please follow our Etiquette policy and Forum rules.
NEW: Sell your art on T-shirts with Merch by Team, journal
NEW: Sell your art on T-shirts with Merch
Sep 16, 2026
Sell your art printed on physical products, right on DeviantArt! Merch is here, starting with T-shirts. Sellers can set up Merch listings on existing deviations or  new ones. Set your markup to determine your earnings, while DeviantArt handles printing, stocking, packing, and shipping. It’s as easy as it sounds. More Merch products will follow, and your feedback can help shape what comes next. [DEVIATION] [DEVIATION] Your wearable art is available in your profile Your audience on DeviantArt already knows and loves your work. Now they can show it by wearing it. Your T-shirt listings appear in your profile, which makes it easy for buyers to discover and order wearable versions of your art. [DEVIATION] Simple setup To convert existing deviations into Merch listings, go to Studio > Published and choose to sell them as Merch. Pick the placement of your art on a T-shirt and set your markup. Then you save, and it’s done! When submitting a new deviation, you can sell it as Merch

Seller Updates: September 2026
Oct 4, 2026
Halloween shoppers are already browsing, looking for reasons to ring in the fall season. Here's what's new in your shop, your Studio, and your community this month! [DEVIATION] [DEVIATION] Your 2026 Halloween Selling Guide Spooky season draws buyers hunting for the creepy and unsettling, and this guide covers it all: what sells (new Merch and custom Originals, plus Arts & Crafts and Exclusives), how to set up your shop and run discounts, and how to get seen before Halloween hits. [DEVIATION] [DEVIATION] Set Up Your Stall at the Monster Market The Monster Market is officially open. Publish a Halloween Exclusive, Arts & Crafts piece, Premium Download, or Merch item and tag it #MonsterMarket2026 by October 15th to earn your badge and a shot at being featured to Halloween shoppers. [DEVIATION] [DEVIATION] More Pro Creator Updates Shop Analytics just got roomier. Core Pro+ and Core Max sellers are no longer capped at 50 rows and can now see tens of thousands. Plus, subscribers
Seller Updates: October 2026 by Team, journal
Seller Updates: October 2026
5 days ago
October brought new ways to connect with your audience, a roundup of Monster Market highlights, and a full set of seller tips. Here's what you need to know. [DEVIATION] [DEVIATION] Polls in more places Polls can now be embedded in journals, statuses, deviation descriptions, and custom sections. They can include fun markup options like bold, italics, and images in your questions and answers. Sellers with Subscriptions can also submit a status or journal poll to a tier to make it subscriber-only. [DEVIATION] [DEVIATION] Fresh from the Monster Market The Monster Market was packed with the creepiest, cutest, and strangest finds on DeviantArt. See the sellers our staff and community volunteers picked across Exclusives, Arts & Crafts, Premium Downloads, and Merch, and explore more at #MonsterMarket2026. [DEVIATION] [DEVIATION] Seller Tips with OHH: Monetization Strategies (all tips) Seller openhighhat has collected all eight Monetization Strategies tips in one journal. Learn
Sending a little light your way by Team, journal
Sending a little light your way
Yesterday
[EMOTE]Sometimes a work of art or a touching comment can just light up your day. 🏮 Through the end of November, thank an artist whose creativity made you smile with the Lantern of Light badge. As the days get shorter, a little light goes a long way. [EMOTE] Awarding it is completely free! Grant some today for 0 gems. [EMOTE] [DEVIATION] [DEVIATION] Awarding Lantern of Light to a deviation or comment 1. Open the deviation or find the comment you would like to recognize. 2. Locate the badge icon beneath it. 3. Select Lantern of Light. 4. Click Award Badge. The badge will be awarded to the deviation or comment and will also appear on the recipient's profile. [DEVIATION] If someone gives you the Lantern of Light, you can find it in your seasonal badges! [DEVIATION] Note: If you have off-topic comments on other areas of DeviantArt, find the corresponding forum thread here. Please follow our Etiquette policy and Forum rules. [DEVIATION]
DeviantArtが日本語で使えるようになりました 🇯🇵 by Team, journal
DeviantArtが日本語で使えるようになりました 🇯🇵
Oct 6, 2026
As part of our ongoing push to make DeviantArt a global home for artists, we're excited to announce our newest language: Japanese!  You can switch your language to Japanese and explore DeviantArt with a localized interface designed to make navigating and participating in the community easier. DeviantArtは、世界中のアーティストにとっての居場所であり続けるために、多言語化を進めています。このたび、新しい対応言語として日本語が加わりました！ 表示言語を日本語に切り替えると、日本語化されたインターフェースでDeviantArtを楽しめます。作品を探す、コミュニティに参加するといった体験が、よりスムーズになります。 How to switch your language Navigate to your Profile dropdown in the top-right navigation bar. Click Language. Select Japanese and click Confirm. We've translated most of DeviantArt into Japanese, and we're adding more every day. If you spot something that's still in English, you're just ahead of the curve, because it's on its way. Deviations and comments will be in the language they were originally posted
Get closer to your fans with Subscribers-Only Channels by Team, journal
Get closer to your fans with Subscribers-Only Channels
Sep 29, 2026
Turn your subscription tiers into communities. Give your subscribers a space of their own to chat with you, connect with each other, and belong to a group of supporters just like them. Subscribers-Only Channels are a new type of Messages channel that connects to your subscription tiers. When someone subscribes, they're added automatically and keep access as long as they’re subscribed, without you needing to lift a finger to manage member lists. It's a private community for the people who back you directly, and it's yours to use however you want. [DEVIATION] Creating a Subscribers-Only Channel You can set up this type of channel when creating or editing subscription tiers, and it’ll show up in your list of tier benefits. You can mix and match channels with your tiers in a way that keeps your community organized the way you want. For example, you can set up one channel for all 3 of your tiers, or create a channel for each tier. [DEVIATION] How Subscribers-Only Channels

Founded in 2000, DeviantArt is the largest online community for artists and art lovers, with over 115 million registered members from 240+ countries and regions worldwide and hosting over 790 million pieces of art on the platform. DeviantArt empowers creators to monetize their work and sell their art online, and in 2025 tens of thousands of artists sold on DeviantArt for over $23 Million.
